error.permission: Microphone permission denied — please allow it in the browser and retry
error.notSupported: This browser does not support voice input
error.backend: Speech recognition failed — check whether the STT service is online
error.stream: Live dictation connection failed — you can switch to record-and-transcribe

settings.desc: Speak into the microphone to fill the input box with text; you review it before sending.

backend.label: Dictation provider
backend.desc: Which service transcribes speech (local CosyVoice / cloud Doubao); Doubao has no live dictation yet, so it always records-then-transcribes

enabled.label: Enable proper-noun biasing
enabled.desc: Feed names/places/custom words to the recognizer to fix homophone errors

strength.label: Biasing strength
strength.desc: Weak = only exact-pinyin matches (safest); Medium/Strong = allow fuzzy sounds, fixes more but may over-correct

dict.label: Proper-noun dictionary (this save)
dict.desc: Names/places are auto-collected; add error-prone proper nouns here. Applies to the current save only.
dict.empty: No custom terms yet — add mis-recognized names here.
dict.noSave: Load a save to edit its proper-noun dictionary.

enabled.label: Enable voice input
enabled.desc: Show the microphone button in the main input and NPC private chat

mode.label: Input mode
mode.desc: Live dictation needs backend streaming; Auto = live when available, otherwise falls back to record

latency.label: Live dictation latency
latency.desc: Faster feels more responsive; steadier is more accurate

pause.label: Pause tolerance
pause.desc: How long a pause before a sentence is cut & punctuated. Long = think-pauses won't split (sentence lands a bit later; Stop flushes immediately)

firstUseHint.label: First-use hint
firstUseHint.desc: The model loads lazily (~10+s the first time); when on, shows a "first time is slower" hint

language.label: Recognition language
language.desc: Chinese / English / Japanese / Korean / Cantonese auto-detected

settings.streamUnavailable: No live dictation service detected; will fall back to record & transcribe
settings.insecureContext: ⚠ The browser has disabled the microphone: this page is served over an insecure address (LAN IP + http). Open it via localhost or https for the mic button to appear.
